commentary: With benchmark indices retreating for three straight sessions and market breadth languishing at 34, Stan Weinstein's stage discipline demands defensive posture and extreme selectivity. Under William O'Neil's market-direction rules, three of four equities follow the prevailing market trend, making aggressive new exposure hazardous amid firm crude, elevated yields, and foreign institutional selling. While Bank Nifty exhibits divergence, overall market pressure caps follow-through. Our discipline requires Stage 2 candidates emerging from low-cheat bases or VCPs with certified earnings acceleration. AAREYDRUGS.technical: Carving a double bottom above rising 50 and 200-day SMAs with a 6.5% handle. RSI at 55 is constructive, but the base lacks decisive volume dry-up, and institutional accumulation remains unconfirmed.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Operating profit margins are weak at 2.8%, with a 3-year average ROE of just 3.4%. Top-line contraction of 56% and erratic EPS fail CANSLIM growth filters despite negligible debt.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Thesis fails on a breakdown below 95.95 handle support; cut losses immediately to guard capital against erratic micro-cap drawdowns.

AARTIPHARM.technical: Displaying authentic Stage 2 power, clearing a 20-day high into new annual highs. Moving averages show pristine bullish alignment, while an RSI of 66 reflects leadership without price exhaustion.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Operating margins expanded to 24.8% with net profit climbing 65% YoY. Xanthine derivatives and CDMO capacity debottlenecking drive powerful fundamental torque with ROCE near 11%.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Pattern breaks down if price closes back below 869.10; enforce the predetermined stop to prevent a false breakout loss.

ABBOTINDIA.technical: Tight consolidation within 1.5% of its pivot on a significant 2.52x volume surge. Moving averages are impeccably stacked, and an RSI of 69 confirms high relative strength.
ABBOTINDIA.fundamental: Impeccable balance sheet featuring zero debt, high return metrics with ROCE exceeding 30%, and 22.7% net margins. However, top-line growth of 4.3% falls short of CANSLIM requirements.
ABBOTINDIA.risk: Setup fails on a drop below the 27,710.37 support floor; cut losses quickly if heavy selling pressure breaches support.

ACE.technical: Constructing an orderly double bottom above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA. RSI at 72 indicates strong relative strength, poised right at neckline resistance with healthy upside momentum.
ACE.fundamental: Domestic leader in mobile cranes with over 60% market share. High ROCE of 31.6%, ROE of 22.8%, and a virtually debt-free balance sheet support institutional accumulation.
ACE.risk: Structure invalidates on a break below the 1,190.33 swing low; exit without hesitation to preserve portfolio equity.

ADANIPORTS.technical: Coiling within 1.5% of pivot on 1.74x volume expansion, maintaining structure above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA. RSI at 63 reflects controlled, constructive accumulation.
ADANIPORTS.fundamental: Operates with robust 58% operating margins and healthy net debt-to-EBITDA of 1.9x. However, net profit growth deceleration to single digits (9%) triggers strict CANSLIM caution.
ADANIPORTS.risk: Pivot thesis fails if price breaks under base support at 1,790.95; honor stop-loss rules immediately.

AEROFLEX.technical: Double bottom reset featuring a low-volume pullback to the rising 21-EMA followed by a decisive bullish reclaim candle near highs. Trend template aligns above 50 and 200 SMAs.
AEROFLEX.fundamental: Sensational CANSLIM profile driven by expanding liquid cooling assemblies. Operating margins hold near 23%, debt is negligible, and ROCE stands at 18.9% with strong institutional backing.
AEROFLEX.risk: Breakdown below the 528.75 pivot floor aborts the setup; execute disciplined risk cut instantly.
